# netactuate_oidc_client (Data Source)

Reads an OIDC Client.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_oidc_client" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `label` (String) Display label for the OIDC client
- `oidc_client_id` (Number) OIDC client ID assigned by the API

### Read-Only

- `account_default` (Boolean) If true, this client becomes the account default OIDC client and can affect resources Terraform does not manage. Leave false unless you intend to change the account default.
- `created_on` (String) Timestamp when the client was created
- `default_audience` (String) Default audience used when a request does not specify one
- `description` (String) Description for the OIDC client
- `enforce_allow_list` (Boolean) Require keyless requests to come from allowed resources
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `jwks_uri` (String) HTTPS URL where the API fetches public JWKs for this client. Mutually exclusive with netactuate_oidc_client_key: a client with a JWKS URI set cannot also have public keys pushed to it, and attempting both fails the apply with HTTP 400.
- `last_used_on` (String) Timestamp when the client was last used, or empty when unused
- `tenant` (String) Tenant value used with third party OIDC services
- `ttl` (Number) JWT lifetime in seconds
